faqs: How often should transmission gear oil be changed?

The recommended interval depends on the vehicle make, model, transmission type, and driving conditions. We recommend checking the manufacturer’s service schedule or having the transmission inspected by our technicians.
What are the signs that my transmission needs servicing?

Common signs include difficulty shifting gears, unusual noises, delayed gear engagement, transmission fluid leaks, or jerking during gear changes. If you notice any of these symptoms, professional inspection is recommended.
Why is the transmission oil filter important?
The transmission oil filter helps remove contaminants from the transmission fluid and supports clean oil circulation. A clogged or worn filter can affect transmission performance.
When does the transmission chamber gasket need replacement?

A gasket may need replacement when it becomes worn or damaged and starts causing transmission oil leaks. During servicing, our technicians can inspect the gasket and recommend replacement if required.
Can regular transmission servicing improve vehicle performance?
Yes. Proper transmission maintenance can support smoother gear shifting, help reduce component wear, and maintain reliable transmission performance.

faqs: How often should I have my car detailed?

What is the difference between waxing and sealing?
Waxing provides a protective layer that enhances shine and offers short-term protection, while sealants offer longer-lasting protection against environmental elements.

What is a clay bar treatment?
A clay bar treatment involves using a clay bar to remove bonded contaminants from the paint surface, resulting in a smoother, cleaner finish.
